description: Keeps a project's newest archived threads visible under its thread list, so recovering one takes a click instead of a search. Turn the row on from the project's ⋯ menu and the archived threads appear dimmed under the live ones. Click one to read it while it stays archived, then unarchive from the row or from the open thread's header. Choose how many it lists — 10, 25, or 50 — and how far back it looks, from 7 days to all of them.
